name: Saskatchewan Immigrant Nominee Program (SINP)
name_fr: Programme Candidats immigrants pour la Saskatchewan
description: Skilled-worker streams of the Saskatchewan Immigrant Nominee Program (SINP) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)

skilled_worker_streams.summary: No job offer; Expression of Interest; at least 60/110 points; CLB 4; TEER 0–3 in-demand occupation not on the excluded list

skilled_worker_streams.stream: International Skilled Worker — Saskatchewan Express Entry
skilled_worker_streams.summary: Express Entry profile and job-seeker code; at least 60 points; TEER 0–3 in-demand occupation; $500 fee

skilled_worker_streams.stream: Talent Pathways (Agriculture, Health, Innovation and Tech)

attributes.notes: At least 750 nominations in 2026 reserved for graduates of Saskatchewan institutions with a priority-sector job offer. Priority sectors: health care, agriculture, skilled trades, mining, manufacturing, energy, technology.
attributes.status_dependency: Eligibility depends on occupation (NOC/TEER), job offer, language scores and existing ties to the province — all unknown (USER-PROFILE.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 2, 4, 7).

sources.title: International Skilled Worker: Saskatchewan Express Entry

verification.notes: Read through search-engine extracts of the provincial programme's official pages, not fetched in full.

limitations: Stream rules change several times a year and intake is often by invitation only; read the provincial guide in force before applying.
